title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,501–1,550 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Compulsory education in Taiwan begins in elementary school.
examples.zh: 台灣的義務教育始於國民小學。

examples.en: She has been my closest friend since our elementary school days.
examples.zh: 她從小學時期開始就一直是我最要好的朋友。

examples.en: The local elementary school is hosting a charity spring fair on the playground.
examples.zh: 當地的小學正在操場上舉辦一場春季慈善義賣園遊會。

examples.en: Students study diverse subjects during junior high school years.
examples.zh: 學生在國中階段研習多樣化的學科領域。

examples.en: He joined the track team during his first semester of junior high school.
examples.zh: 他在國中一年級第一學期加入了田徑隊。

examples.en: Junior high school teachers help teenagers navigate key developmental years.
examples.zh: 國中老師引導青少年順利度過關鍵的成長發育期。

examples.en: Senior high school students prepare diligently for college entrance exams.
examples.zh: 高中生為大學學科能力測驗勤奮備戰。

examples.en: Taipei First Girls' High School is a renowned senior high school in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台北市立第一女子高級中學是台灣極負盛名的高級中學。

examples.en: Participating in extracurricular clubs is an unforgettable part of senior high school life.
examples.zh: 參加課外社團活動是高中生活中難以忘懷的重要一頁。

examples.en: Vocational schools provide specialized technical and practical training.
examples.zh: 技職高職提供專業技術與實務技能培訓。

examples.en: Graduates from vocational schools often possess hands-on skills favored by industry employers.
examples.zh: 技職學校的畢業生通常擁有深獲業界雇主青睞的實作技能。

examples.en: He enrolled in a vocational school to master automotive repair and mechanics.
examples.zh: 他進入一所技職學校就讀以專精汽車修護與機械原理。

examples.en: National Taiwan University is located in the Daan District of Taipei.
examples.zh: 台灣大學位於台北市大安區。

examples.en: Going to university offers students opportunities to explore diverse career pathways.
examples.zh: 進入大學就讀為學生提供了探索多元職業發展路徑的機會。

examples.en: The university library stays open twenty-four hours during final exam week.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館在期末考週期間全天二十四小時對外開放。

examples.en: She decided to apply for graduate school to pursue AI research.
examples.zh: 她決定申請研究所深造以進行人工智慧研究。

examples.en: Graduate school requires self-motivated independent research and critical thinking.
examples.zh: 研究所需要高度自律的主動獨立研究與批判性思維能力。

examples.en: Funding through research assistantships helps graduate school students pay expenses.
examples.zh: 研究助理獎助學金的資助有助於研究生支付生活開銷。

examples.en: It typically takes four years to complete a bachelor's degree.
examples.zh: 修畢學士學位通常需要花費四年時間。

examples.en: Having a bachelor's degree opens doors to numerous entry-level professional jobs.
examples.zh: 擁有學士學位能為眾多基層專業職缺敞開就業大門。

examples.en: She earned a bachelor's degree in computer science with highest honors.
examples.zh: 她以最優異的頂尖成績獲得了資訊工程學士學位。

examples.en: He holds a master's degree in electrical engineering.
examples.zh: 他擁有電機工程碩士學位。

examples.en: Pursuing a master's degree allows professionals to specialize in their chosen field.
examples.zh: 攻讀碩士學位能讓專業人士在所選領域進行深造專精。

examples.en: She defended her master's degree thesis before a panel of distinguished scholars.
examples.zh: 她在傑出學者評審委員會面前順利完成了碩士學位論文答辯。

examples.en: Professor Lin received her PhD from Oxford University.
examples.zh: 林教授在牛津大學取得了博士學位。

examples.en: Completing a PhD demands years of rigorous academic publication and original inquiry.
examples.zh: 完成博士學位需要多年嚴謹的學術論文發表與原創研究探索。

examples.en: He is currently a PhD candidate conducting cutting-edge biotechnology research.
examples.zh: 他目前是一名正在進行頂尖生物科技研究的博士候選人。

examples.en: The lush green campus is shaded by tall historic banyan trees.
examples.zh: 綠意盎然的校園內綠樹成蔭，遍植歷史悠久的古榕。

examples.en: Electric rental bikes are convenient for traveling across the large university campus.
examples.zh: 租賃電動腳踏車在遼闊的大學校園內穿梭代步非常便利。

examples.en: Safety emergency phones are positioned strategically throughout the college campus.
examples.zh: 緊急求救電話在大學校園各處皆設有妥善規劃的求助據點。

examples.en: Living in the university dormitory is a great way to make lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 住在大學宿舍是結交終生好友的極佳途徑。

examples.en: Each dormitory room accommodates four students with study desks and bunk beds.
examples.zh: 每一間學生宿舍寢室配有書桌與上下鋪，供四位學生同住。

examples.en: The resident advisor oversees building safety rules within the dormitory.
examples.zh: 舍監督導負責維護宿舍大樓內部的各項安全公約守則。

examples.en: The campus cafeteria serves affordable and nutritious set lunches.
examples.zh: 校園學生餐廳供應平價且營養均衡的套餐午餐。

examples.en: We met up at the central cafeteria to grab a quick coffee between classes.
examples.zh: 我們下課空檔在中央學生餐廳碰面喝杯咖啡。

examples.en: Vegetarian and halal dietary options are clearly labeled in the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 學生餐廳內對素食與清真飲食選項皆有清楚標註。

examples.en: The graduation ceremony was held in the school auditorium.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮在學校大禮堂隆重舉行。

examples.en: The guest speaker stood at the podium in the center of the vast auditorium.
examples.zh: 客座演講貴賓佇立在宏偉大禮堂中央的演講台前。

examples.en: Hundreds of freshmen gathered in the auditorium for orientation day briefings.
examples.zh: 數百名大一新生齊聚在禮堂聽取新生開學宣導說明。

examples.en: Put on safety goggles before conducting chemistry experiments in the lab.
examples.zh: 在實驗室進行化學實驗前請戴上護目鏡。

examples.en: The advanced research laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art instruments.
examples.zh: 這座尖端研究實驗室配備了最先進的一流儀器設備。

examples.en: Unauthorized personnel are strictly forbidden from entering the biohazard laboratory.
examples.zh: 未經授權的人員嚴禁擅自進入生物危害管制實驗室。

examples.en: School basketball finals will be played inside the main gymnasium.
examples.zh: 全校籃球決賽將在主體育館內進行。

examples.en: The multi-purpose gymnasium accommodates both volleyball and badminton matches.
examples.zh: 這座多功能體育館可容納排球與羽毛球比賽進行。

examples.en: Rain forced the annual athletic sports meet into the indoor gymnasium.
examples.zh: 降雨迫使年度體育運動大會移師至室內體育館舉行。

examples.en: Professor Wang delivered an insightful lecture on environmental science.
examples.zh: 王教授發表了一場關於環境科學的精闢專題演講。

examples.en: Don't be late for the 9 AM economics lecture in the main hall.
examples.zh: 早上九點在大講堂進行的經濟學大堂課切勿遲到。

examples.en: My parents gave me a stern lecture about managing my personal finances wisely.
examples.zh: 父母親嚴肅地對我訓誡了一頓，告誡我務必明智管理個人財務。

examples.en: The professor encouraged students to ask challenging questions.
examples.zh: 教授鼓勵學生勇於提出具挑戰性的問題。

examples.en: You can visit the professor during her scheduled weekly office hours.
examples.zh: 您可以在教授每週排定的諮詢時間前往研究室拜訪討論。

examples.en: The associate professor published an influential paper in an international journal.
examples.zh: 這位副教授在國際頂尖期刊上發表了一篇極具影響力的論文。

examples.en: The principal gave an inspiring welcome speech on the opening day.
examples.zh: 校長在開學典禮當天發表了激勵人心的致詞。

examples.en: The school principal met with concerned parents to discuss campus renovations.
examples.zh: 學校校長與關心校務的家長會面，共同研商校園整修工程。

examples.en: Lack of adequate investment was the principal cause of project failure.
examples.zh: 缺乏充足的資金挹注是專案最終遭遇失敗的首要主要原因。

examples.en: The dean of academic affairs announced next year's new curriculum.
examples.zh: 教務長公布了明年度的全新課程規劃。

examples.en: Students with exceptional grade point averages are honored on the Dean's List.
examples.zh: 學業平均成績出類拔萃的學生榮獲列入學院優秀名譽榜單。

examples.en: The college dean approved funding for the new scientific research laboratory.
examples.zh: 學院院長核准了興建新科學研究實驗室的專案補助經費。

examples.en: Download the English course syllabus from the university portal.
examples.zh: 從大學入口網站下載英語課程大綱。

examples.en: The syllabus clearly outlines assignment due dates and grading criteria.
examples.zh: 課程大綱詳細清楚列出了作業繳交截止日期與評分評核標準。

examples.en: Check the syllabus carefully before emailing the professor about exam schedules.
examples.zh: 在寄信向教授詢問考試日程前，請先仔細查閱課程大綱。

examples.en: The fall semester in Taiwan usually begins in early September.
examples.zh: 台灣的大學秋季學期通常在九月初開學。

examples.en: She decided to study abroad in Germany for one exchange semester.
examples.zh: 她決定前往德國進行為期一個學期的海外交換研習。

examples.en: Students often feel intense stress during the final weeks of the semester.
examples.zh: 學生在學期最後幾週通常會感受到沉重巨大的學業壓力。

examples.en: You need at least 128 course credits to qualify for graduation.
examples.zh: 你需要修滿至少 128 個課程學分方具備畢業資格。

examples.en: Give credit where credit is due when working in cooperative teams.
examples.zh: 在團隊合作時，凡是有所貢獻者都應給予其應得的肯定與讚譽。

examples.en: Do you accept international credit cards for course registration fees?
examples.zh: 請問繳納課程註冊學費時接受國際信用卡刷卡嗎？

examples.en: She decided to major in international business administration.
examples.zh: 她決定主修國際企業管理。

examples.en: Climate change is one of the major global challenges of our era.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是我們這個時代所面臨的最主要全球挑戰之一。

examples.en: He decided to switch his college major from biology to software engineering.
examples.zh: 他決定將大學主修學系從生物學轉為主修軟體工程。

examples.en: He chose Japanese as his academic minor subject.
examples.zh: 他選擇日語作為他的輔修學科。

examples.en: The car sustained only minor surface scratches in the parking lot mishap.
examples.zh: 這輛汽車在停車場小擦撞中僅受到表面輕微刮痕。

examples.en: In many countries, individuals under age eighteen are legally considered minors.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，未滿十八歲的個人在法律上均被視為未成年人。

examples.en: Freshman English is a compulsory course for all university freshmen.
examples.zh: 大一英文是所有大學新鮮人的必修課程。

examples.en: Nine years of compulsory education is guaranteed by national law.
examples.zh: 國家法律保障國民享有九年義務強制的基礎教育。

examples.en: Wearing safety helmets on motorcycles is compulsory in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣騎乘機車強制規定必須佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: Students can choose between music and art as an elective subject.
examples.zh: 學生可在音樂與美術之間選擇一門作為選修科目。

examples.en: Taking diverse elective courses broadens your academic and career perspectives.
examples.zh: 修習多樣化的選修課程能開拓你的學術涵養與職涯視野。

examples.en: She enrolled in a digital photography elective class to learn image editing.
examples.zh: 她選修了一門數位攝影選修課以學習影像後製修圖技能。

examples.en: Regular class attendance is factored into your final semester grade.
examples.zh: 平常課堂出席率會計入您的學期總成績。

examples.en: Overall attendance at the annual technology exhibition set a new record.
examples.zh: 年度科技博覽會的整體參觀出席人數創下了嶄新歷史紀錄。

examples.en: The teacher calls roll every morning to take daily student attendance.
examples.zh: 老師每天早晨點名以確實記錄學生的每日出勤狀況。

examples.en: Why were you absent from English class yesterday morning?
examples.zh: 你昨天早上英文課為什麼缺席沒來？

examples.en: He had an absent look on his face while lost in deep thought.
examples.zh: 他陷入沉思時臉上帶著若有所思、心不在焉的神情。

examples.en: Students who are absent more than three times cannot take the final exam.
examples.zh: 曠課缺席超過三次以上的學生將不得參加期末考試。

examples.en: Do not skip class, or you will fail the midterm exam.
examples.zh: 不要翹課，否則期中考會考不及格。

examples.en: He skipped class to play video games with friends and got reprimanded.
examples.zh: 他為了跟朋友打電玩而翹課，結果遭到了嚴厲訓誡。

examples.en: Skipping classes repeatedly will lower your semester participation points.
examples.zh: 屢次曠課翹課將會大幅拉低你的學期課堂參與分數。

examples.en: Take detailed notes during lectures to help with exam revision.
examples.zh: 上課時隨手做詳細筆記有助於考前溫習複習。

examples.en: It is effective to take notes using colored pens and mind maps.
examples.zh: 使用彩色原子筆和心智圖來做筆記是非常高效的學習法。

examples.en: The secretary took careful notes throughout the confidential executive meeting.
examples.zh: 秘書在整場高層機密會議中仔細做下了會議記錄筆記。

examples.en: The midterm exam will cover chapters one through six.
examples.zh: 期中考試範圍將涵蓋第一章至第六章。

examples.en: Library study rooms are fully booked during the midterm exam period.
examples.zh: 圖書館自習室在期中考期間全部被預約客滿。

examples.en: She scored ninety-five on her organic chemistry midterm exam.
examples.zh: 她在有機化學期中考中考取了九十五分的高分。

examples.en: Good luck to everyone on your upcoming final exams next week!
examples.zh: 祝大家下週即將到來的期末考一切順利！

examples.en: The comprehensive final exam accounts for forty percent of the course grade.
examples.zh: 綜合期末考占全門課程總評分權重的百分之四十。

examples.en: Students cheered in relief after walking out of their last final exam.
examples.zh: 走出最後一場期末考考場後，學生們如釋重負地放聲歡呼。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a ten-word vocabulary pop quiz today.
examples.zh: 老師今天給我們考了十個單字的隨堂單字小考。

examples.en: You can take an online interactive quiz to test your grammar proficiency.
examples.zh: 您可以參加線上互動測驗以檢測自身的文法精熟度。

examples.en: The pub hosts a lively trivia quiz night every Wednesday evening.
examples.zh: 這家酒館每週三晚上都會舉辦氣氛熱烈的常識問答測驗之夜。

examples.en: Practice speaking English fluently for the speaking oral exam.
examples.zh: 多多練習流利開口說英語以備戰英語口試。

examples.en: Candidates faced a panel of three native professors during the oral exam.
examples.zh: 應試考生在口試期間面對由三位母語教授組成的考官評審團。

examples.en: Preparing short cue cards helps reduce nervousness during an oral exam.
examples.zh: 準備簡要的小提示卡有助於減輕口試時的緊張焦慮感。

examples.en: Cheating during examinations results in immediate zero marks and disciplinary action.
examples.zh: 考試作弊將導致該科零分並遭受校規懲處。

examples.en: Some athletes use banned substances to cheat in competitive tournaments.
examples.zh: 部分運動員使用違禁藥物在競爭賽事中弄虛作假不法作弊。

examples.en: He felt cheated after discovering the luxury handbag was a counterfeit replica.
examples.zh: 在發現那個名牌精品包只是仿冒贗品後，他深感遭到欺騙。

examples.en: She worked hard and earned straight-A grades this semester.
examples.zh: 她用功讀書，這學期拿下了全科滿分 A 的優異成績。

examples.en: The teacher spent all weekend grading history essay assignments.
examples.zh: 老師花了一整個週末為歷史申論題作業批改評分。

examples.en: Grade school students are eager to participate in science fairs.
examples.zh: 小學年級的小學生們熱切期盼參加自然科學展覽會。

examples.en: You must submit your official academic transcript when applying for colleges.
examples.zh: 申請大學時必須檢附官方正式成績單。

examples.en: Request a sealed copy of your university transcript from the registrar.
examples.zh: 向教務處註冊組申請一份加蓋密封章的大學成績單正本。

examples.en: The court reporter provided an accurate transcript of the legal trial proceedings.
examples.zh: 法庭書記官提供了法庭訴訟審訊過程的精準速記謄本記錄。

examples.en: I studied late every night and finally passed the GEPT test!
examples.zh: 我每晚苦讀，終於通過了全民英檢（GEPT）！

examples.en: Show your security pass at the entrance gate before entering the premises.
examples.zh: 進入廠區前請在大門警衛處出示您的安全通行證識別證。

examples.en: Time passes remarkably fast when you are immersed in engaging work.
examples.zh: 當你全神貫注沉浸在引人入勝的工作中時，時間過得飛快。

examples.en: Anyone scoring below sixty points will fail the course.
examples.zh: 任何得分低於六十分者該課程將被評為不及格。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to fail, because failure is a valuable stepping stone to success.
examples.zh: 不要害怕遭遇挫敗，因為失敗是通往成功的寶貴墊腳石。

examples.en: The old water pump failed during the coldest night of winter.
examples.zh: 那台老舊抽水馬達在寒冬最冷的一夜徹底停止運轉故障了。

examples.en: Sixty is the minimum passing grade in most Taiwanese schools.
examples.zh: 六十分是台灣多數學校規定的最低及格標準。

examples.en: You must achieve a passing grade on the certification exam to get the license.
examples.zh: 您必須在專業證照考試中取得及格分數才能順利獲頒執照。

examples.en: He worked tirelessly to raise his test scores comfortably above the passing grade.
examples.zh: 他堅持不懈地苦讀，將測驗分數遠遠提升至及格標準以上。

examples.en: Outstanding students are awarded academic merit scholarships.
examples.zh: 品學兼優的傑出學生獲頒優秀學業獎學金。

examples.en: Winning a full scholarship enabled her to study abroad without financial burdens.
examples.zh: 榮獲全額獎學金使她得以毫無財務負擔地赴海外深造留學。

examples.en: The corporate foundation funds dozens of university research scholarships annually.
examples.zh: 該企業基金會每年資助數十項大學學術研究獎學金。

examples.en: Public university tuition in Taiwan is relatively affordable.
examples.zh: 台灣國立公立大學的學費相對親民實惠。

examples.en: Private universities often charge much higher tuition fees for undergraduate programs.
examples.zh: 私立大學的大學部學程通常收取高出許多的學費開銷。

examples.en: He worked part-time as a tutor to help pay for his tuition and living expenses.
examples.zh: 他兼職擔任家教以賺取自己的大學學費與日常生活開銷。

examples.en: My elder sister will graduate from high school this coming June.
examples.zh: 我姐姐即將在今年六月自高中畢業。

examples.en: Recent university graduates often seek internship opportunities to gain work experience.
examples.zh: 應屆大學畢業生往往透過尋求實習機會來累積實務工作經驗。

examples.en: She graduated with top honors in international relations from National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 她以最優異頂尖的成績自台灣大學國際關係學系畢業。

examples.en: We took many joyful photos in our caps and gowns at graduation.
examples.zh: 我們在畢業典禮上穿著學士袍開心地拍了許多合照。

examples.en: My grandparents flew across the country to attend my college graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母搭機橫跨國境專程前來參加我的大學畢業典禮。

examples.en: After graduation, he plans to backpack across South America for three months.
examples.zh: 畢業之後，他計畫前往南美洲進行為期三個月的背包自助旅行。

examples.en: Frame your high school diploma and hang it proudly on the wall.
examples.zh: 將高中畢業證書裝框，自豪地掛在牆上。

examples.en: You must present your original university diploma when signing the employment contract.
examples.zh: 簽訂正式聘僱合約時，必須出示大學畢業證書正本。

examples.en: The culinary academy awards an internationally certified diploma upon program completion.
examples.zh: 完成專業烹飪培訓課程後，該學院會頒發國際認證文憑證書。

examples.en: Famous alumni contributed funds to build the new library.
examples.zh: 知名傑出校友捐資興建了全新的圖書館。

examples.en: The annual university alumni reunion brings former classmates together from around the globe.
examples.zh: 一年一度的大學校友重聚會將來自全球各地的昔日同窗齊聚一堂。

examples.en: Many successful alumni mentor current undergraduate students entering job markets.
examples.zh: 許多卓有成就的優秀校友擔任即將邁入職場的大學生的職涯導師。

examples.en: Scientists are conducting groundbreaking research on clean green energy.
examples.zh: 科學家們正在對乾淨綠色能源進行開創性研究。

examples.en: Carry out extensive market research before launching a new product line.
examples.zh: 在推出全新產品線之前，務必先進行廣泛深入的市場研究調查。

examples.en: The university library provides access to thousands of peer-reviewed research databases.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館提供了檢索數千個同儕審查學術研究資料庫的權限。

examples.en: Graduate students spend months writing their master's thesis.
examples.zh: 碩士研究生花費數月撰寫其碩士學位論文。

examples.en: The central thesis of the essay argues that biodiversity is critical to planetary health.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的核心論點主張生物多樣性對地球整體健康至關重要。

examples.en: She submitted the final bound copy of her doctoral thesis to the academic committee.
examples.zh: 她將精裝裝訂完成的博士學位論文正式提交給學位學術委員會。

examples.en: Revise your vocabulary notes every evening before going to bed.
examples.zh: 每天晚上睡前把單字筆記重新溫習一遍。

examples.en: The editor asked the author to revise the final three chapters of the novel.
examples.zh: 責任編輯要求作者修改小說的最後三個章節。

examples.en: The economic agency revised its gross domestic product forecast upward.
examples.zh: 經濟評估主管機關將年度國內生產毛額預估值向上進行修正。

examples.en: Reading good books enriches our minds and broadens our knowledge.
examples.zh: 閱讀好書能豐富我們的心靈並拓寬我們的知識見聞。

examples.en: Practical hands-on experience transforms textbook theory into applicable real-world knowledge.
examples.zh: 實務操作經驗能將教科書理論轉化為切實可行的實務知識。

examples.en: To the best of my knowledge, the project deadline has not been altered.
examples.zh: 據我所知，該專案的最後截止期限並未遭到任何修改變動。
